ordering: Pairs alternate; three arms rotate and reverse across six rounds.

scope.automatic: Per-loader singleflight output strings. A full consumer rebuild regenerates the complete producer; no persistent cross-snapshot extraction cache.
scope.consumer_reuse: Generation is outside steady consumer-edit timing; normal Program cloning reuses declaration ASTs and existing owned output.
scope.producer_changes: Producer edit, watched-file notification, regeneration when required, consumer diagnostics and background drain are all timed.
scope.read_counters: Successful underlying producer/src ReadFile calls/bytes only. SnapshotFS can serve cached inputs during regeneration; these are not extraction calls or cache hit/miss counts.
scope.retention: Post-GC marginal live heap, not RSS/peak. Prepared text is shared; automatic generated output and tracking state are owned separately per Session.
scope.source_control: Same new benchmark functions on exact production25 and final runtime; source-only arm bounds overhead outside automatic mode.
scope.project_harness: Package tests frozen at25; benchmark file frozen at33 in both binaries. Only unrelated physical-output regression is omitted to avoid APIs absent at25; no benchmark code changes.
